parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence and no documented visitor-facing exclusion (border, facility or custody rule) are in the dossier, which keeps this above severe tiers. Against that, the 2024 NGO report documents torture, sexual violence and extortion against LGBT people, and a trans woman faced death threats, including legislators calling for her to be burned alive. Police took 12 hours to respond to a 2012 arson attack, hate-crime protection is ambiguous, there is no anti-discrimination statute, and public acceptance is very low (5/100). Events were cancelled under threat, and expression and assembly are restricted. Visitor-specific prevalence and custody placement are unsourced, so the rating rests on the hostile climate and weak recourse rather than a documented universal exposure. This places it in the high-to-elevated band.
